s.t:
Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Büro in München: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

Who We Are BioMarin is a global biotechnology company that relentlessly pursues bold science to translate genetic discoveries into new medicines that advance the future of human health.

Since our founding in 1997, we have applied our scientific expertise in understanding the underlying causes of genetic conditions to create transformative medicines, using a number of treatment modalities. Using our unparalleled expertise in genetics and molecular biology, we develop medicines for patients with significant unmet medical need.

We enlist the best of the best – people with the right technical expertise and a relentless drive to solve real problems – and create an environment that empowers our teams to pursue bold, innovative science.

With this distinctive approach to drug discovery, we’ve produced a diverse pipeline of commercial, clinical and preclinical candidates that have well-understood biology and provide an opportunity to be first-to-market or offer a substantial benefit over existing therapeutic options.

About Commercial Our Commercial organization leads our global sales and marketing strategies around the world. Our integrated team continues to solidify BioMarin’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children.

These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating, and have few, if any, treatment options.

BioMarin aims to improve life and health outcomes for people with rare diseases by advocating the use of innovative BioMarin therapeutics, advancing the standard of care and providing personalized support and services globally. BioMarin’s Commercial organization supports our global sales and marketing efforts around the world.

Our global sales force continues to solidify the company’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Job Details: Are you a problem-solver who excels at sales? Do you thrive on building relationships? Are you interested in joining a fast-growing team? Rise25 is looking for an Business Development Representative to develop and maintain client accounts and accelerate company growth.

You will also be the primary client contact with Rise25 clients and you will help with implementing our strategy to help clients to get ROI, clients and strategic partnerships using done-for-you podcasts and content marketing.

Job Description: Your primary responsibilities will be conducting discovery calls and market research to generate leads and prospects. You will foster interest and identify and propose solutions to client problems, forging profitable opportunities for business development.

You’ll also be one of our contacts with Rise25 clients and you’ll help with meeting with clients to implement our strategy. This role is perfect for you if you are motivated and rewarded by seeing the results of your contributions.

The right candidate will be a highly structured and process driven team member that can operate effectively in our fast paced and dynamic environment. You will have proven expertise in prioritizing and managing multiple simultaneous projects.

Direct experience in building client relationships, establishing project strategy and deliverables, managing project resources and client expectations are requisites. The ideal person has experience with business development, strategy or sales because you will be giving advice to clients on business development, sales, and referral marketing.

People who would thrive in this position may have the following experience: business development, accountability coaching, business coaching, physical trainer or fitness instructor (you are good at motivating people), or former military background (you are good at following through on a plan and meeting objectives). Key Responsibilities:
Conduct high-level discovery calls with target and prospect accounts
Work from existing leads to build and grow the business.
Research accounts, identify key players, and generate interest through cold discovery calls and email campaigns.
Perform solution-based selling to new prospects.
Utilize your active listening skills to understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Rise25 can solve them.
Generate new business opportunities to fuel our pipeline.
Consistently achieve established quotas to ensure revenue and growth objectives.
Be the project leader and primary client contact in managing all phases of the strategy behind the podcast and utilization of the podcast as a tool for business development.
Develop a strong relationship with the client and provide insight and ideas
Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement
Provide leadership and direction for day-to-day project operations and provides guidance to other members of the team (i.e. writers, editors, developers, etc.)
This position is remote and self-paced . Ideally, we are looking for someone who can devote at least 20 or more hours per week, but if you have fewer hours available at least initially, that is OK. You must be good at self-direction and taking initiative. In addition, it is important to us that all of our team members are detail-oriented and meticulous; therefore, in the application form below, when it asks for your “favorite vegetable?” please fill in the word “eggplant.” Required Skills:
You have 1+ year of experience in Sales or Business Development
You have customer-facing experience and strong problem-solving skills
You have a track record of success in a performance and metrics-driven role
You are quick with communication via email, Slack, and phone
You are nice – we spend a lot of time working, so we want to be on a team with nice people
You are passionate about helping B2B clients to get referrals and customers using podcasts
You are able to hold clients accountable
You are able to strategize with clients
Bonus points if you have been involved in some way with podcasting, radio, or other related media activity (but not required)

Fast-Frogward Your Career to Years From Now
Be part of a team where your work directly shapes the way the world’s top companies build and secure their software.

At JFrog, as a Business Development Representative , you’ll play a key role in bringing our industry-leading solutions to market, helping customers like Amazon, Google, and Netflix solve their most pressing DevSecOps and AI/ML challenges.

Every day offers new opportunities to collaborate, strategize, and innovate in a fast-paced, growth-driven culture. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to make an impact in the world of software, JFrog is the place for you.
We are seeking a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our fast-growing Sales Development team! In this role, you will work closely with Marketing and Sales to help drive JFrog’s solutions. You will develop new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, calling, email campaigns, and inbound lead follow-up
What You’ll Be Doing As a BDR
In this role, you’ll be a key player in our fast-paced and highly innovative engineering team. You will:
Be the first point of contact for new business prospects and expose them to JFrog products and value proposition.
Navigate complex business environments and uncover and translate needs into business opportunities.
Research and evaluate prospect accounts prior to engagement.
Interact with prospects through direct phone calls, emails, and social media.
Generate new business pipeline through outbound prospecting activities and inbound lead follow-up.
Maintain sales data through Salesforce that will influence monthly/quarterly sales reports, pipelines, forecasts, etc.
Collaborate with sales and marketing to build a sales strategy for generating new prospects.
If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements below – that’s okay, nobody’s perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.

s.h: What You Bring To The Table
s.t:
2+ years of B2B / B2D SaaS BDR experience - with a proven track record of success - Must, experience in selling deep-tech products to technical roles - preferred
Experience in prospecting, calling, and emailing to generate new leads
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Self-sufficient and motivated by individual and team achievement
Highly organised with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently
Salesforce knowledge and use of sales automation tools (Salesloft, Outreach, etc.)
BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
Excellent spoken and written English
About JFrog
JFrog is the only end-to-end software supply chain platform that provides complete visibility, security, and control for automating the delivery of trusted releases from code to production. Our platform enables organizations to manage, secure, and automate their software delivery process, fueling innovation without worry. We empower companies to build and release software faster and more securely than ever before.
With over 7,500 customers worldwide, including many Fortune 100 companies, JFrog is at the forefront of global innovation. Join us in shaping the future of software delivery and contributing to solutions that empower some of the world's most influential industries.

**Qui sommes-nous?**
Le CPI (Centre de Perfectionnement Interprofessionnel), basé à Fribourg depuis 1986, est un centre public de formation continue pour adultes. Nous proposons plus de 250 cours, préparons aux certificats et brevets fédéraux, et gérons également des dispositifs de formation mandatés par le service public de l-emploi ainsi que par l-Office AI du canton. Certifié ISO 21001:2018, nous plaçons au cœur de notre mission la qualité, l-adaptabilité et l-accompagnement professionnel des adultes.
Pour notre domaine de formation en langues, nous recherchons un-e responsable de domaine.
L'offre de formation en français et en allemand s'adresse à des publics adultes variés et combine plusieurs règlementations : des mesures du marché du travail (MMT) mandatées par le Service public de l'emploi (SPE) pour les demandeur-euse-s d'emploi, des cours de français fide et de français destinés aux personnes migrantes dans un objectif d-intégration, ainsi que des cours pour des particuliers et des entreprises.

Le poste combine la conduite d'une équipe de 2 gestionnaires de formation et une douzaine de formateur-trice-s occasionnel-le-s. La part de conduite est estimée à 30-40%. Vous formez également dans l'une ou l'autre langue, ce qui représente 60-70% du cahier des charges.
**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**
Rejoindre le CPI, c'est contribuer au développement des compétences qui façonnent l'avenir. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement collaboratif, stimulant et innovant, où l'initiative est encouragée et où chacun peut avoir un impact concret. Ensemble, nous accompagnons les personnes et les organisations dans leur évolution professionnelle

* Évaluer les pratiques pédagogiques

ABOUT YOU & THE ROLE 🚀 What is Synera ? — Where AI Meets Deep-Tech Synera is on a mission to accelerate engineering with AI. We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Our AI agents integrate seamlessly with the tools engineers already use, remove bottlenecks in real-world product development, and help deep-tech companies move faster without compromising quality. In a world where engineering speed is a competitive advantage, Synera is defining the new standard.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us. 👉 Your Role Joining us as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) in the US, you’ll be the first voice our future customers hear — C-level deciders, engineering leaders, innovation teams, and thought leaders at forward-thinking deep-tech companies.

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities. Let’s be real: this role is hands-on. You’ll spend a lot of time picking up the phone, sending messages, following up, and getting through to tough prospects.

Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. Pipeline Building: You qualify leads and set up meetings for the Account Executive team.
Prospect & Qualify: You engage senior leaders and decision-makers via cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls, reaching 60+ activities per day).
Outbound Excellence: You shape and manage targeted outbound campaigns, working with the Marketing team to optimize messaging.
Engage & tell great stories: You spark interest in Synera ’s Agentic AI solutions through compelling storytelling and value-driven conversations. You experiment and find creative ways to engage with senior leaders and build trustful relationships
Iterate & Improve: You analyze outreach performance, test new approaches, and refine our SDR playbook.

You know our domain inside out: who our ideal customers are, what keeps them up at night, and how Synera solves their biggest challenges. You have become an AI native, and curiosity is what drives you daily.
You routinely create great Discovery Calls, proving you can turn outreach into meaningful conversations for our Sales team. You have gained great confidence in explaining and pitching a complex tech product.
You are a power user of our tools and workflows - from prospecting platforms to CRM systems. Giving and receiving feedback has become a normal part of your day.
You understand what makes our product special and be able to speak authentically about the value we bring to teams who want to transform what they do with AI. You love to share knowledge and good practices in an international team.

Intermediate (OTE): 85.000 - 109.000$

Access to the mental health platform nilo to support your well-being.

Regular team events, in the US or abroad (Germany)🌈

About LiveKit
LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.
Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.
This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.
You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.

Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.
Partner tightly with enterprise AEs on account strategy you'll co-own named accounts, align on entry points, and run coordinated multi-threaded plays to break into large organizations
Research target accounts to craft highly personalized, technically credible outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone
Book discovery calls and product demos for enterprise AEs; provide full context so they walk in sharp and prepared
Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion
Surface market intelligence back to the product and GTM teams as you're often the first to hear what buyers care about
Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

1–3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company
Genuine curiosity about technology; you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold an intelligent conversation about why a company might choose a managed WebRTC platform over a self-hosted stack
Strong written communication - you know the difference between an email that gets deleted and one that gets a reply
Experience with sales engagement tools and Salesforce
Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
Comfort working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written and flexibility is required

Background selling to engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML teams
Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communications, or WebRTC concepts
Experience at an open-source company with a PLG motion - you understand what it means when a developer has been building with your product for 6 months before the first sales conversation
Experience using AI tools to accelerate prospecting and personalization at scale
Why LiveKit
Enormous market. Real-time AI is becoming a requirement for nearly every enterprise application. We're the infrastructure layer, and we're well ahead of the field.
Incredible developer traction. Our sales team doesn't cold-call strangers they engage with a community that already loves the product.
Technical credibility. You'll sell something that engineers respect. That matters if you care about representing products you believe in.
Trajectory. This is a ground-floor opportunity on an enterprise sales team at a company with serious investor backing, strong revenue growth, and the reference customers to close big deals.

Competitive comp: Base + uncapped commission + equity. We want SDRs who want to win.

Company Description
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world.

Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

Bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of relevant work experience.
3+ years experience as a sales development representative with a track record of achieving lead/sales quotas.
Experience in a SaaS and/or Ed Tech environment is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience initiating and nurturing relationships with potential customers using targeted outbound prospecting techniques (social media, email, phone).
Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM is required.
Flawless communication skills (oral and written) and comfort presenting to prospects.
Proven ability to work autonomously and as a productive team member, demonstrating a strong work ethic and a proactive approach.
Experience using prospecting applications like LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Proven creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
Full proficiency in English
Full proficiency in Spanish and Italian
Core competencies for success in this role include Accountability, Resourcefulness, Collaboration & Influencing, and Curiosity.

Experience representing a company at industry events, trade shows, or webinars.
An additional European language is a plus.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

### Votre mission: ###
· Accompagner un retour au travail, ce qui ne consiste pas simplement à aider quelqu'un à trouver un emploi
· Aider une personne à retrouver progressivement une capacité à fonctionner dans un environnement professionnel, à identifier ses ressources et ses limites, à reconstruire des repères et à développer une manière de travailler qui soit à la fois réaliste et durable
· Allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel

Vous serez responsable de l'accompagnement individuel d'un portefeuille de participants tout au long de leur mesure de réadaptation. Concrètement, vous :

· animez des workshops et des journées de formation en groupe
· contribuez à créer un environnement de réentraînement qui se rapproche du fonctionnement réel d'une entreprise, tout en respectant les objectifs et les limites de la mesure
· collaborez étroitement avec les conseillers AI, professionnels de santé, employeurs et autres partenaires impliqués, et notamment lors de séances réseau

### Description du poste ###
Dans le cadre d-une mission auprès de l-un de nos clients, nous recherchons un(e) **Consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) et technique Salesforce** disposant d-une expertise confirmée sur **Salesforce Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud**.
**Le taux d'activité est de 50%.**
Vous interviendrez dans un environnement où Salesforce occupe une place centrale dans la gestion de la relation client, avec pour objectif d-optimiser les processus, d-améliorer la personnalisation des interactions et de renforcer l-automatisation des campagnes marketing.
## Vos missions ##
Vous intervenez à la fois sur les dimensions **fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles** des plateformes Salesforce.
### Salesforce Marketing Cloud ###

* mettre en place et optimiser la segmentation des audiences,
* concevoir et automatiser les campagnes marketing : journeys, triggers, requêtes SQL,
* créer et adapter des templates de newsletters,
* développer des modèles de reporting permettant de mesurer la performance des campagnes,
* assurer les intégrations avec le CRM et les autres systèmes internes.
### Salesforce Sales Cloud ###

* l-implémentation et l-optimisation de workflows automatisés,
* la création et la configuration de champs techniques et d-objets,
* la personnalisation des tableaux de bord et du reporting,
* l-optimisation du pipeline commercial,
* l-intégration de Sales Cloud avec des systèmes externes, notamment via API.
## Support et accompagnement des utilisateurs ##
Vous assurez également un rôle de référent fonctionnel et technique auprès des équipes :
* support sur Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud,
* accompagnement dans l-utilisation quotidienne des segments, workflows, dashboards et campagnes,
* formation des équipes internes afin de renforcer progressivement leur autonomie.
## Amélioration continue et gouvernance ##
Vous participez activement à l-optimisation et à la gouvernance des plateformes Salesforce :
* audit régulier des environnements Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud,
* analyse et nettoyage des segments, doublons et workflows devenus obsolètes,
* définition et mise à jour des bonnes pratiques d-administration,
* mise en place de conventions de nommage, règles d-archivage et standards documentaires,
* proposition d-améliorations fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles,
* recueil et clarification des besoins métiers,
* animation d-ateliers avec les équipes internes,
* rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles,
* définition et suivi de la gouvernance Salesforce,
* prise en compte des exigences de conformité **GDPR et LIPAD**.
## Gestion des évolutions et des environnements ##
Dans le cadre des différents projets Salesforce, vous assurez également :
* le suivi des évolutions et nouvelles implémentations,
* la gestion du cycle de vie des environnements, notamment de la sandbox vers la production,
* la mise en place et la supervision des processus de sauvegarde et de restauration ;
* la documentation systématique des changements,
* le suivi et le reporting de l-avancement des travaux.
### Profil recherché ###
Vous êtes titulaire d-un **Bachelor dans le domaine informatique ou d-une formation équivalente**.
Vous disposez d-une expertise confirmée sur **Salesforce Marketing Cloud**, notamment sur :
* Automation Studio
* Journey Builder
* Email Studio
* SQL Query
* intégrations API.
Vous possédez également une solide expérience de **Salesforce Sales Cloud**, incluant notamment :
* Process Builder / Flows
* champs personnalisés
* objets Salesforce
* dashboards
* reporting.
Une expérience dans l-intégration de Salesforce avec des sites web, CRM et autres systèmes via API est attendue. Vous maîtrisez également les principes de gouvernance Salesforce, l-analyse de données marketing et les bonnes pratiques en matière de sécurité et de conformité GDPR/LIPAD.
## Compétences fonctionnelles ##
Une bonne compréhension des environnements métiers suivants est recherchée :
* marketing et web-marketing
* e-commerce
* commerce lié au transport de voyageurs
* retail et ventes en boutique.

s.t:
This role requires availability to work Monday through Thursday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, as well as 4 hours on Friday and 4 hours on Saturday as part of the regular weekly schedule.
Meet LLC Hub
At LLC Hub (a division of GBS Group ), we focus on helping entrepreneurs and executives create opportunities by building better businesses. We know that a solid, compliant start is critical for future success, and that's where you come in.
We specialize in Start-Up Services, providing a complete suite of offerings to get new companies compliant and running efficiently, including:
Company state registration + EIN Request
Registered Agent and Virtual Address services
Compliance services like Annual Report Filing and Corporate Obligations Notification
Tax support, including Corporate Tax Return Filing and a 30-minute appointment with a Tax Advisor
Our differentiation is our Deep Business Experience and commitment to Find Solutions and Create Simplicity, guiding clients through the complex initial stages with clarity and expertise.
Role
We’re looking for a Sales Representative (Closer) who knows how to consistently show up, follow through, and close deals in a fast-paced sales environment. You will be the primary closer for inbound and warm leads interested in LLC Hub’s Start-Up Services.
This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable following proven sales processes and scripts in both English and Spanish, motivated by closing results, and confident building urgency, handling objections, and guiding prospects through the sales process.
Success in this role requires strong follow-up discipline, resilience, accountability, and the ability to consistently execute daily activity expectations while delivering an excellent client experience.
Your role is to embody GBS Group ’s core values — Client First, Kind Candor, and Pursue Growth and Learning — by putting clients first, building genuine rapport, and communicating effectively to ensure every prospect feels valued and understood from the first interaction, while remaining committed to continuous growth and high performance.

Daily Activity (Open to Goal Mandate): Execute 8 to 12 calls/meetings per day with qualified prospects. This is a mandatory daily KPI and the expectation for being "Open to Goal" is that work continues until this activity quota is met.
Expert Education: Educate prospects on LLC Hub's Start-Up Services and compliance offerings from an expert, consultative perspective.
Pipeline Management: Maintain a clear, accurate, and observable pipeline in the CRM. Move all prospects to the proper stage throughout the day.
Documentation: Diligently document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM notes.
Diligence: Follow up diligently and consistently with potential clients over extended periods.
Collaboration: Collaborate with the team to ensure smooth transitions from sales to service.
Key Results (KPIs)

s.h: These metrics define high performance in this role
s.t:
Show Rate: Maintain a Show Rate >70% (Percentage of scheduled meetings that actually occur).
Close Rate: Maintain a Close Rate >20% (Percentage of meetings converted to sales).
Sales Performance: Directly contribute to Sales Revenue and optimizing Sales Cycle Time.
Pipeline Hygiene: All prospects are properly moved in the CRM and client information is fully documented by EOD.
Follow-Up Consistency: All qualified prospects are consistently followed up with indefinitely.

Compensation: Guaranteed Base Salary + Uncapped Commission. OTE is $45k - $60k.
Work Ethic (Open to Goal): We operate with an Open to Goal philosophy. This means that work is driven by daily activity metrics, and the commitment is to meet your mandatory activity KPIs (8-12 calls) regardless of the clock, aligning your effort directly with your uncapped earning potential.
Development: Internal training and coaching, leveraging GBS Group 's deep business and advisory experience to help you grow rapidly.
Work/Life: Flexible Time Off Policy and Company-wide Holidays.

3+ years of high-volume transactional sales experience (e.g., event tickets, gym memberships, subscriptions, or similar B2B/B2C services).
3+ years of direct closing experience in high-volume, short sales cycle environments (same-day close or sales cycles under 30–45 days).
Proven ability to handle objections, negotiate, and consistently close deals.
Experience selling service-based offerings to inbound and warm leads.
Experience with CRM management and pipeline tracking.
Communication: Excellent communicator over phone and video conference in Spanish and English, with a great ability to present complex information clearly.
Self-Management: Self-sufficient and able to properly manage your own time and an organized sales pipeline.
Mindset: Routine driven, open to learning new sales processes, and focused on finding solutions and creating simplicity for our clients.
